grammar.why: Before a vowel the article shortens to "l'": l'amico.
Words ending in a stressed vowel don't change.
Movement verbs take "essere" + participle agreeing in gender.
After a modal verb comes the infinitive.
Italian often inverts subject and verb.
Adjectives usually follow the noun: casa grande.

stories.title: Il primo giorno a Roma
stories.text:
Ali arriva a Roma la mattina.
Prende un taxi fino all'___ (1).
In camera beve un ___ (2).
Poi chiama la sua ___ (3).
stories.en: Ali reaches Rome in the morning. He takes a taxi to the hotel. In the room he drinks a coffee. Then he calls his family.

stories.title: Al mercato
stories.text:
Sara va al ___ (1) la domenica.
Compra pane, latte e ___ (2).
Paga con la ___ (3).
stories.en: Sara goes to the market on Sunday. She buys bread, milk and apples. She pays by card.

stories.title: Il passaporto perso
stories.text:
Ahmad cerca il suo ___ (1).
Chiede aiuto a un ___ (2).
Per fortuna lo trova nella sua ___ (3).
stories.en: Ahmad is looking for his passport. He asks a policeman for help. Luckily he finds it in his bag.

stories.title: Dal medico
stories.text:
Bilal non sta ___ (1).
Va dal ___ (2).
Il medico gli dà la medicina e ___ (3).
stories.en: Bilal is unwell. He goes to the doctor. The doctor gives him medicine and rest.

stories.title: Il corso di italiano
stories.text:
Nadia impara l'___ (1) da tre mesi.
Si esercita ogni sera con i ___ (2).
Il suo ___ (3) dice che parla già bene.
stories.en: Nadia has been learning Italian for three months. She practises every evening with books. Her teacher says she already speaks well.

stories.title: Pranzo in famiglia
stories.text:
Domenica arriva tutta la ___ (1).
La nonna cucina il ___ (2).
Tutti mangiano insieme e ___ (3) molto.
stories.en: On Sunday the whole family comes. The grandmother cooks rice. Everyone eats together and laughs a lot.

stories.title: Alla stazione
stories.text:
Il treno ha dieci minuti di ___ (1).
Hassan compra un ___ (2) al chiosco.
Poi sale sul ___ (3).
stories.en: The train is ten minutes late. Hassan buys a newspaper. Then he gets on the train.

stories.title: Una sera d'inverno
stories.text:
A gennaio fa molto ___ (1).
Aisha mette un ___ (2) caldo.
Beve un ___ (3) caldo e legge.
stories.en: In January it is very cold. Aisha wears a warm coat. She drinks hot tea and reads.

stories.title: Cena in albergo
stories.text:
Il cameriere porta il ___ (1).
Omar ordina pesce e ___ (2).
Alla fine chiede il ___ (3).
stories.en: The waiter brings the menu. Omar orders fish and rice. At the end he asks for the bill.

stories.title: Nuovi amici
stories.text:

Alla fine si scambiano i ___ (3).
stories.en: Lena and Sana meet in the park. They talk about music and travel. At the end they exchange their numbers.
